rec.name: Cost Transparency (Price Breakdown) Section

what.text: A configurable Shopify section called 'CRO | Kostentransparenz' that explains how the price is made up. A headline and sub-headline sit above a row of round or rounded-square images. Each image carries a bold percentage and a label, e.g. '45% Development & Production', '25% Staff', '20% Sales', '10% Profit'. Below that is a text block with its own headline, copy and an optional image or badge. The final build has two blocks, left and right. The left block is the cost breakdown. The right block reuses the same image row and adds a size/serving chart with up to 5 rows (icon, title, package images, amount). If only one block is active it stretches to 100% width. If both are active they are 50/50 on desktop and stacked on mobile.

why.text: Customers often object to a high price. Showing what the money pays for (ingredients, people, sales, profit) makes the price feel fair and justified. This reduces price scepticism and builds trust through openness. Concrete percentages and friendly imagery are easier to process than a claim like 'quality has its price'. A closing 'promise' text and a badge or award add credibility. The effect should be strongest on premium-priced products.

how.text: 1) Create the section file ed-cro-Kostentransparenz.liquid (see the attached installation TXT) and paste the code. 2) Add the section to the product template (below the product content). 3) Add a 'Left block' and optionally a 'Right block'. 4) In the left block, fill in the heading and heading size, the rich-text sub-content, the images with labels (e.g. '45% Development & Production'), the image style (circle or rounded) and the footer heading, text and image. 5) Optionally fill in the right block's size chart. 6) Set the section colors, spacing and gaps. Styling is scoped to the section ID. Image sizes are set in px for desktop and mobile. On screens below 1000px the blocks stack and the image row scrolls horizontally. With one block the layout becomes 100% width through an 'ed-{{blocks.size}}' class.

items: Left and right block background colors and text colors
Section padding top and bottom (desktop and mobile)
Block heading text with H-size selector
Block sub-headline as rich text (bold and italic available in the editor; underline was reported as missing during QA)
Feature image style: circle or rounded square
Per feature item: image and rich-text label (percentage plus name). The ticket asked for up to 5; the code visible in the source has 4 per block
Footer heading and size, footer rich text
Footer image: upload, position (left, center or right), max width, top margin (desktop and mobile)
Right block size chart: heading plus up to 5 rows with icon, title, package image, 'repeat' count and text

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify OS 2.0 theme that supports sections with blocks. The code relies on a '.container' wrapper and the CSS variables --base-font-size and --heading-h5-font-size from the theme. No apps are used. The ticket says a metafield is probably not needed ('MF/N'), so all content is set in the theme editor. The source code snippet is truncated at the end.

items: Scroll depth and section view rate

images.caption: Reference design (Hundpur): headline 'Quality has its price', sub-headline, four circular images with percentages 45/25/20/10 and labels, a 'Our promise' text block and a badge at the bottom right.
Concrete percentages and a closing promise justify the price and build trust.

Theme editor: 'Cost transparency' section with Left and Right blocks. The right block is shown as an orange feeding-recommendation layout (four round images with labels, size chart rows with package icons, footnote and a bowl image). The settings panel shows heading, H3 size, rich-text content, gap, image width desktop/mobile, image style 'circle', and per-item image and label.
Block-based structure in the section tree and the per-block settings used to build it.
